class.name: IfcMotorConnection
class.brief_description: A motor connection provides the means for connecting a motor as the driving device to the driven device. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcMotorConnection defines the occurrence of any motor connection; common information about motor connection types is handled by IfcMotorConnectionType .
